svg.title: task-card-pastel-peach-picture-left-query-beside-it-criteria-column-responses-below
svg.desc: pale peach rounded card with a spaced sans title at the upper left, a square picture slot (grey here) with the magenta Q label and question beside it, two dashed grey criteria boxes with tan C labels and bold magenta preference tags stacked at the right, and two italic responses led by magenta R1 and R2 labels along the bottom | source: iclr26-0076_fig1 (iclr26-0076_fig1_p4_mixed.svg) | candidate wave1:task-card-pastel-peach-picture-left-query-beside-it-criteria-column-responses-below | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role

text.tspan: Short, swirling brushstrokes (impasto technique) and complementary color
yellow) create visual turbulence and movement.
It feels like a restless dream
the undulating sky seems to pull you inward,
evoking a profound sense of unease.
